scope: Add a permission-controlled, audited maintenance-mode control to Admin Health while preserving administrator recovery access and the pre-update maintenance state.

evidence: backend/src/admin.ts: maintenance mutation requires the admin.system permission and resolves the actor from the authenticated session
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: maintenance controls are hosted on the privileged Admin Health surface
backend/src/admin.ts: maintenance state changes are serialized with a PostgreSQL advisory lock and restored if Activity recording fails
backend/src/admin.ts: every state change records structured before and after values
backend/src/admin.ts: MAINTENANCE_ENABLED and MAINTENANCE_DISABLED events record actor, time, source, reason, system record ID, and route
operations/Maintenance-On.ps1 and Maintenance-Off.ps1: emergency console controls require confirmation and reason
operations/Status-Inventory.ps1: status output reports maintenance state, operator, and reason
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.test.tsx: privileged UI control requires reason and invokes the maintenance API
operations/Invoke-InventoryUpdate.ps1: updater restores the exact maintenance state that existed before the update
deployment/web.config: maintenance preserves authentication, Admin recovery, API health, and static assets
backend/test/app.test.ts: health and authentication remain available while protected non-admin workflows return structured maintenance status
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Health shows Operational or Maintenance active state with operator, time, reason, busy state, and failure feedback
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: maintenance confirmation uses the shared Overlay with backdrop, Escape, close, fixed actions, and focus behavior
